shared_elements: curved arch-like motifs (top of A / head area of B)
justification: Both are carved stone surfaces with some rounded/arched motifs and a circular element, but A is a flat horizontal slab with a row of arches over small figures (birds, animals) while B is a freestanding anthropomorphic stele with a head, facial features, and a chest disc. The overall composition, scale, and subject matter (narrative frieze vs. single humanoid figure) differ substantially, so the resemblance is superficial and limited to generic curved and circular shapes.
